mentions.name: Astro Starter Template
mentions.description: A light, performant, non-bloated and scalable starter template for Astro that uses markdown/MDX for content, plain CSS with styling tokens defined in a var.css, and other conventions suited to any web project, with good UI/UX for blogs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've also built a starter template for Astro which is light, performsnt, non-bloated and scalable. It uses markdown / MDX for content, plain CSS with styling tokens defined in a var.css, and other things I would use for ever web project. It's very good for blogs also, none of the usual UI and UX problems many blogs often have.

Astro Starter Template: https://starter.bryanhogan.com/
mentions.author: bryanhogan
